sentences.en: This word is pronounceable, but it sounds really strange.
sentences.zh: 这个词发得出，但听起来很奇怪。

sentences.en: The name is not pronounceable in English, so most people just say 'Jay' instead.
sentences.zh: 这个名字用英语发不出来，所以大多数人就说‘杰’代替。

sentences.en: I had to look up how to pronounce this word because it's not very pronounceable.
sentences.zh: 我查了怎么发音，因为这个词不太发得出。

senses.zh: （指声音）发得出的；（指词）可发音的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pronounce（发音）+able（可…的）→（指词）可发音的
